name: Dead Letter from the Roster Deck
description: A starship's crew-roster terminal has gone quiet, but local services remain online. Recover the protected crew record from the lab network. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Recover the crew record
tasks.description: Find the exposed crew-operations services on the lab network and recover the protected record. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: Compare the reachable services and look for crew-operations material available without signing in.
An operational backup can retain account details intended for another service. Inspect what the exposed service offers.
Use the recovered account to sign in to the other service, then read the crew mailbox record.
